title: Analyst - Master Data Management
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market\-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world.


A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.


**Job Summary**
---------------

\&\#xa;\&\#xa;  

  

  

To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, We’re looking to add a **Analyst \- Master Data Management** in **Coimbatore** , India.  



  

The Analyst – Master Data Management performs analysis, provide reports, information to create and maintain vendor master records and updates vendor setup. Additionally, work with suppliers and buyer groups to resolve Pricing.  



  

**What a typical day looks like:**

* Manage transactional interactions with suppliers.
* Work with suppliers and buyer groups to resolve Pricing and other commercial T\&Cs
* Provide reports, information, analysis etc., as required, in a timely, professional manner
* Maintain good level of public relations with outside suppliers as well as a strong
* partnership with internal customers
* Maintain the Vendor Master Records/Updates/New Vendor Setup
* Advise stakeholders of modifications from original requests
Obtain price and other non\-pricing information from approved suppliers  
* 

  

**The experience we’re looking to add to our team:**

* Education: Bachelor’s Degree
* Experience \- 0\-2 Years
* Proficiency: ERP/P2P systems BAAN / SAP/ Oracle
* Mandatory Knowledge of computer software applications, MS Excel, Word \& PowerPoint.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Knowledge of ERP (Preferably BAAN) preferred
Flexible to work in all shifts  
* 

  

**What you’ll receive for the great work you provide:**

* Health Insurance
PTO  
* 

  

\#SS16


**Job Category**
----------------

Global Procurement \& Supply Chain

title: Pricing & CPQ - Analyst 2
description:
**Job Title \- Pricing \& CPQ \- Analyst \- ACS SONG**

**Management Level: Level 11 \- Analyst**

**Location: Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad**

**Must have skills: PROS Smart Price Optimization**

**Good to have skills: Pricing Tools**

**Experience: 2\-3 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**

**Job Summary**


Results\-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid\-size to enterprise organizations. Skilled in platforms such as PROS CPQ with a strong focus on pricing strategy, product configuration, discounting rules, and quote\-to\-cash automation. Adept at collaborating with cross\-functional teams—sales, finance, product, and IT—to gather business requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver accurate, efficient quoting processes.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus
* Build robust pricing models using advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to track key pricing KPIs, and build leadership dashboards in visualization tools.
* Work on assessing pricing processes in alignment with business imperatives and client’s sales strategy through client data diagnostics and gap analysis including current state assessment and future state design, Vendor assessment and selection.
* Work on designing and implementing pricing waterfall, pricing strategy, competitive pricing, pricing elasticity, margin analysis, pricing diagnostics, pricing catalog, and contract pricing of services, leading to a positive impact on topline and bottom line for global B2B organizations
* Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis \& Reporting), target state analytics recommendation
* Work on recommending and deploying process improvements and enablers with best\-in\-class KPIs
* Work as an integral part of the client’s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
* You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing \& CPQ area.
* The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

  

**Professional and Technical Skills:**

* 2\-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications \& High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
* Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization \& Management (POM) \& Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
* Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
* Knowledge of other Pricing \& CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

**Additional Information**

* Nice to have certification in any one of the following or equivalent from other pricing/CPQ solutions
* PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management  

PROS Smart Configure Price Quote

title: Head – Data Analytics & AI
description:
Head – Data Analytics \& AI12 \- 16 YearsSBC Office, Pune (PNQ02\)Full\-TimeAbout ComprinnoComprinno is a NASSCOM\-incubated company headquartered in Bangalore, with offices in Pune, Coimbatore, and the United States. We specialize in cloud transformation, DevOps, infrastructure automation, and Artificial Intelligence, enabling organizations to build scalable, secure, and high\-performing cloud environments on AWS.Our flagship SaaS platform, **Tevico**, offers intelligent cloud governance and observability for AWS workloads. It helps enterprises improve uptime, reduce costs, and ensure compliance by proactively detecting anomalies and triggering automated remediation workflows.As an AWS Advanced Consulting Partner, Comprinno helps organizations migrate, modernize, secure, and operate cloud environments while adopting emerging technologies such as Data Analytics, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.About the RoleWe are looking for a visionary, entrepreneurial, and execution\-focused **Head – Data Analytics \& AI** to establish, scale, and lead Comprinno's Data Analytics \& AI function.Reporting directly to the CTO, this role will be responsible for defining the strategy, building the team, developing service offerings, driving innovation, ensuring delivery excellence, and shaping Comprinno's long\-term Data \& AI vision.This is a leadership role with end\-to\-end ownership of the Data \& AI organization, including Data Engineering, Analytics, Machine Learning, MLOps, Generative AI, and Agentic AI capabilities. The role will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Alliances, Cloud Engineering, and Customer Success teams to build a strong market presence and accelerate business growth.The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership and consulting experience and has a proven track record of building high\-performing teams and delivering impactful data\-driven solutions for enterprise customers.Key ResponsibilitiesStrategy \& Practice Leadership

* Define and execute the vision, strategy, and growth roadmap for Comprinno's Data Analytics \& AI function.
* Build a scalable and differentiated Data \& AI capability aligned with market opportunities and customer needs.
* Identify emerging technology trends and align investments with business priorities.
* Develop annual practice plans, capability roadmaps, and strategic initiatives.
* Establish operating mechanisms, KPIs, and success metrics for the function.
* Shape Comprinno's Data \& AI thought leadership and market positioning.

Service Portfolio \& Offerings Development

* Develop and evolve service offerings across:
* Data Engineering
* Data Platforms \& Modernization
* Data Analytics \& Business Intelligence
* Machine Learning
* MLOps
* Generative AI
* Agentic AI
* AI Governance
* Data Governance
* Build reusable frameworks, accelerators, templates, and reference architectures.
* Drive productization of services and identify opportunities for SaaS and IP\-led offerings.
* Contribute to AI capabilities within Tevico and future AI\-powered products.

Customer Advisory \& Solution Leadership

* Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives, business leaders, and technology teams.
* Lead discovery workshops, strategy discussions, and solution design engagements.
* Translate business challenges into scalable Data \& AI solutions.
* Present solution recommendations, roadmaps, and transformation strategies to stakeholders.
* Support strategic pursuits, proposal development, solution reviews, and technical validations.
* Ensure successful delivery of high\-impact customer engagements.

Team Building \& Leadership

* Build and lead a high\-performing team of:
* Data Engineers
* Data Scientists
* AI Engineers
* Analytics Consultants
* Solution Architects
* Establish career frameworks, competency models, and capability development programs.
* Mentor future technical and practice leaders.
* Drive hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, and succession planning initiatives.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, learning, and customer obsession.

Delivery Excellence \& Governance

* Establish delivery methodologies, governance frameworks, and quality standards.
* Ensure consistent execution across customer engagements.
* Drive best practices across Data Engineering, Analytics, MLOps, and AI Engineering.
* Monitor delivery health, customer satisfaction, utilization, and project outcomes.
* Promote operational excellence and continuous improvement across the function.

Technology Leadership \& Innovation

* Provide technical leadership across:
* Data Engineering
* Analytics
* Machine Learning
* MLOps
* Generative AI
* Agentic AI
* Evaluate emerging technologies, platforms, and ecosystem partners.
* Lead innovation initiatives, proof\-of\-concepts, and applied research activities.
* Promote AI\-assisted development and modern engineering practices.
* Guide development of reusable IP, accelerators, and solution frameworks.

Partner Ecosystem \& AWS Alignment

* Build strong relationships with AWS and strategic ecosystem partners.
* Align the Data \& AI function with AWS programs and initiatives.
* Collaborate with AWS teams to identify joint opportunities and innovation programs.
* Represent Comprinno at AWS events, executive briefings, partner forums, webinars, and industry conferences.
* Strengthen Comprinno's positioning within the AWS Data \& AI ecosystem.

Business Growth \& Market Development

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Alliances teams to drive pipeline creation and business growth.
* Support enterprise account planning and expansion strategies.
* Contribute to revenue growth through solutioning, customer engagement, and practice development.
* Assist in pricing strategies, service packaging, and go\-to\-market initiatives.
* Build market awareness and thought leadership around Comprinno's Data \& AI capabilities.

Required Qualifications \& Skills

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, or related disciplines.
* 10–15 years of experience across Data Engineering, Analytics, AI/ML, Cloud Data Platforms, or Data Consulting.
* Minimum 4 years of leadership experience managing teams, functions, or practices.
* Proven experience building and scaling Data, Analytics, AI, or ML capabilities within consulting, technology, or services organizations.
* Strong expertise across:
* Data Engineering
* Analytics
* Machine Learning
* MLOps
* Generative AI
* AI Platforms
* Deep understanding of modern data architectures including:
* Data Lakes
* Lakehouses
* Data Warehouses
* Data Mesh
* Real\-Time Streaming Platforms
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS Data \& AI services including:
* Amazon Bedrock
* Amazon SageMaker
* AWS Glue
* Amazon Redshift
* Amazon Athena
* Amazon OpenSearch
* AWS Lake Formation
* Experience with modern technologies such as:
* Snowflake
* Databricks
* Spark
* Kafka
* Airflow
* MLflow
* LangChain
* LangGraph
* CrewAI
* AWS Certifications in Data Analytics, Machine Learning, Solutions Architecture, or Generative AI.
* Experience building IP\-led, accelerator\-led, or SaaS\-enabled service offerings.
* Strong customer\-facing consulting and stakeholder management experience.
* Excellent leadership, communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Experience building and mentoring high\-performing technical teams.

Desired Qualifications \& Skills

* MBA or equivalent business qualification.
* Experience participating in AWS programs related to Data, Analytics, AI/ML, or GenAI.
* Strong network within the Data, Analytics, and AI ecosystem.
* Thought leadership demonstrated through speaking engagements, publications, webinars, blogs, or industry participation.
* Experience working across industries such as BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare, or Technology.
* Strong understanding of Data Governance, Responsible AI, Privacy, and Regulatory Compliance frameworks.

What We're Looking For

* Strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities.
* Strong technical credibility combined with business acumen.
* Customer\-first mindset with consulting orientation.
* Passion for innovation and emerging AI technologies.
* Ability to build and inspire high\-performing teams.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and leadership qualities.
* Collaborative leader capable of influencing across functions and stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

* Establishes a scalable and differentiated Data Analytics \& AI function.
* Builds a high\-performing and respected Data \& AI team.
* Launches successful service offerings and reusable accelerators.
* Delivers measurable customer outcomes through Data \& AI initiatives.
* Builds strong executive relationships with customers and AWS stakeholders.
* Contributes significantly to revenue growth through practice development and solution leadership.
* Establishes Comprinno as a recognized Data \& AI partner within the AWS ecosystem.
* Drives innovation, thought leadership, and market differentiation.

Why Join Comprinno

* Opportunity to build and lead a strategic technology function from the ground up.
* Direct influence on company strategy, innovation, and growth initiatives.
* Work with one of the leading AWS partners in APJ.
* Engage with cutting\-edge technologies across Data Engineering, Analytics, AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI.
* Collaborate closely with AWS and strategic technology partners.
* Build market\-leading offerings, accelerators, and future SaaS products.
* Join an entrepreneurial, high\-growth environment that values ownership, innovation, and impact.

Pay: Up to ₹4,800,000\.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What is your notice period?
* Do you have any AWS certifications?
* How many years of experience do you have in Data Engineering?
* What is your highest educational qualification?

Work Location: In person
